now.title: Daredevil S1#9
now.text: Foggy Nelson digs with Karen and Ben Urich for something in Fisk's past to use against him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord Foggy digs into.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Lawyer who digs into Fisk's past.

proposed.text: Foggy Nelson digs into Fisk's operations with Karen, Matt and Ben Urich, looking for the link between Westmeyer-Holt and Confederated Global.

changes.evidence: In Daredevil S1#9 'Speak of the Devil', Ben Urich meets Karen and Foggy, and with Matt they decide to find the connection from Westmeyer-Holt Contracting to Confederated Global Investments to reach Fisk. They are digging into his current operations, not his past (Fisk's past is dug up later by Karen and Ben).

now.title: Marvel Zombies#2
now.text: Katy joins Kamala's group with Shang-Chi after the Raft falls.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Shang-Chi's best friend, now Kamala's too.

proposed.text: Katy and Shang-Chi's group reaches the Raft along with Kamala's, and the two groups agree to work together.

changes.evidence: In Marvel Zombies #2, Shang-Chi's group (with Katy) arrives at Zemo's Raft along with Kamala's group and both agree to work together; only afterwards does Namor's attack sink the Raft. The groups join at the Raft, not after it falls.

owner_calls.question: The X-Men: Days of Future Past stage already mentions the earlier bar scene in X-Men: First Class, where young Charles and Erik try to recruit Logan and he brushes them off. Should that meeting get its own earlier stage on X-Men: First Class?
options: Keep as is: one stage on Days of Future Past that mentions the bar scene
Add a stage 0 on X-Men: First Class (kind rival or ally) for the bar scene, with Days of Future Past as stage 1
owner_calls.evidence: In X-Men: First Class, Charles and Erik approach Logan in a bar to recruit him and he turns them away (Hugh Jackman's cameo, which won Best Cameo). The current stage 0 text refers to it as backstory but no stage sits on that title.
